title: Prenuvo arc section
description: A section wrapper whose top edge is a wide, shallow convex arc (25px deep on phones, 50px from 1024px) that tucks over the section before it, so the previous section shows in the two corners.
notes: the arc is a clip-path ellipse three widths wide, so its depth stays the same at every screen width
give it a background: the arc only shows against the section above
